PG.rationale: PG is a high-quality defensive franchise with excellent brand equity, strong margins (51% gross, ~24% operating), and consistent cash generation supporting 70+ years of dividend increases. However, the near-term trajectory is mixed: Q3 FY2026 showed solid YoY growth (+7.4% revenue, +5.8% EPS) but sequential deceleration (QoQ revenue -4.4%, EPS -8.4%), and management guided toward the lower end of its FY2026 range due to tariff and commodity headwinds. The stock has pulled back ~11.5% over the past quarter to $142.71, and at a P/E of 22.4x it sits near the low end of its 12-month range (21.7-26.7x), suggesting modest valuation support.
